audit_event.notes: cascade=false is explicit on the wire; descendant Mandates retain their pre-revoke state. RR still broadcasts the parent's revocation within RevocationVisibilityBudget.

irreversibility_note: Even with cascade=false, the parent's Revoked status is irreversible. A new Mandate covering the parent's scope requires a fresh BOOTSTRAP.
notes: Boundary case for §5.3.5 cascade default. The vector explicitly sets cascade=false and records the expected post-state for both descendants (Active) so implementations cannot silently revoke children when the wire says otherwise.

post_state.note: cascade=false leaves descendants Active. Per Requirement 7.2.2, no NEW DELEGATE can be issued with the Revoked parent as `parent_mandate`, but existing children retain their state until they expire on their own `not_after` or are explicitly revoked.

signature_verification.note: REVOKE envelope is signed by HP (Requirement 4.1.3 — REVOKE auth-strength ≥ BOOTSTRAP auth-strength). REVOKE_RECEIPT / ERROR is signed by MS. Both envelopes use canonical CBOR as signing input regardless of wire encoding.

summary: REVOKE with cascade=false on a depth-2 tree; only the parent becomes Revoked; descendants stay Active. Validates that ``cascade`` is an explicit, wire-level boolean rather than implementation-defined behaviour.
trigger: iFay reports task completion (DISCLOSURE → HP confirmation)
